in_sanskrit.name: Raval
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है The Protector
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Raval एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Raval is a Sanskrit and Hindu name meaning 'The Protector'. It is derived from the root word 'Rav' which means to protect, preserve and nourish. This name is bestowed upon a child to instill in them a sense of responsibility and a strong desire to protect and care for others.
